Visual research · separate from your game

Graphics-first visual overhaul · detail pass 2.

This separate graphics experiment keeps your live v0.8.1 game safe. Lab 10 replaces generated placeholder textures with embedded, high-detail surfaces and a cloud-filled sky, adds architectural finishes, and replaces rounded tree tops with layered leaf cards. Visual quality remains a work in progress—not a photorealistic finished game.

Heads-up: the human model loads from a public GLB reference library. If the model download fails, a procedural fallback will appear. An internet connection is required, just like your current game.

No purchases, installs or changes to your main game save. Desktop and mobile share the same website. This build is mainly about world presentation. We kept the gameplay base, but this pass invests more in visual detail and environment richness.
